description: Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha - Declare as a Developed Area
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property-related matters, specifically the declaration of developed areas within the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha for the purpose of imposing assessment tax. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, geographic coordinates, and property specifications, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land use planning and zoning changes.
